svg.text: Round 18 Architect FAQ: Edge & Desktop AI Agent (AI PC / NPU SLM) vs. Hybrid Cloud Broker
Local Inference ≠ Auth Security · Cross-Window UIAutomation/Clipboard Harvesting · Client Forgery · 64 Scenarios / 194 Pytest Passed

❌ Treating Local Inference as Security (Global Scrape + Client Check)
1. Cross-Window Accessibility & Clipboard Harvesting (EDGE-CLIPBOARD-ACCESSIBILITY-49)
• External vendor email toast pops up while finance restricted-budget is open on screen
• Local 4-bit quantized NPU SLM scrapes full-screen UIAutomation tree & obeys toast
• Uses ambient SSO session to overwrite deliverable & leak M&A floor to supplier!
2. Client-Side Policy Bypass & Step-ID Payload Swap (EDGE-CLIENT-FORGERY-50)
• Guardrails running inside the endpoint process are bypassed via local memory/DB patch
• Compromised edge reuses step-0000 to swap send_message into $980 request_payment
• Or replays pre-pause offline epoch=0 token to execute unauthorized $980 wire!
3. Why On-Device Quantized SLMs Are More Vulnerable Than Cloud Frontier Models
• 3B–7B models compressed to INT4 suffer instruction-hierarchy alignment degradation
• OS-wide Accessibility access collapses process isolation between browser & finance apps
Baseline Outcome: Cross-window leak + deliverable tamper + $980 wire (75.0% ASR)
✅ Window-Origin Taint + Hardware TPM + Cloud Capability Broker
Defense 1: OS Window-Handle (HWND / Origin) Taint Tagging
• Ban global background scraping; scope capture to explicit active window handle
• Any browser/mail toast in view stamps context with untrusted=True & external requester
• Cloud Broker enforces record-owner & restricted-data-boundary against leaks!
Defense 2: 'Edge Proposes, Cloud Capability Broker Disposes'
• Strip direct DB/wire keys from endpoint; local SLM acts only as Untrusted Proposer
• Authoritative server ledger verifies operation_id + SHA-256 request_hash & epoch
• Raises Conflict in 0.0248ms on client step-ID swaps or stale offline epoch replays!
Defense 3: TPM 2.0 / Secure Enclave Sealing + AppContainer Sandbox
• Encrypt proprietary local GGUF/ONNX weights with hardware TPM PCR-bound keys
• Confine local MCP stdio tools inside AppContainer/Seatbelt away from ~/.ssh & cookies
Hardened Outcome: BRK-45 / BRK-46 100% Blocked · 0 Violations · 0.0% FPR
🧭 AI Solution Architect Selection Rules & Provenance-Sealed Latency
